title: Top 8 SAM Traps — Exam & Real World

narrations.text: Top 8 SAM Traps. Exam & Real World — Memorize These
These 8 traps cause 90% of SAM failures. 4 are technical, 4 are process. Know them cold for the exam and for real life.

Trap 1: Metric Mismatch (Silent Killer). Model metric: Per Device | Entitlement metric: Per User Reconciliation runs, produces plausible number Result: MEANINGLESS — comparing different counting bases Fix: Enforce metric match at entitlement creation (client script) Exam: 1 silent reconciliation failure.

Trap 2: Duplicate Installs (Inflated Demand). SCCM + Intune + Discovery = 3x same install Demand inflated → false under-licensed → unnecessary true-up Fix: Configure dedup rules (samswdeduprule) — Exact / Major / Any match Tiebreak: Most recent, most complete, or priority source.

Trap 3: Unnormalized Titles (Hidden Unlicensed). Discovery model 'Office16 ProPlus' unmatched Auto-creates separate software model → separate reconciliation Result: False unlicensed / unknown positions Fix: Normalize BEFORE auto-create (property: com.snc.samp.automaticsmrcreation).

Trap 4: Maintenance Treated as License. Maintenance-only PO line → entitlement created Reconciliation counts it as usage rights Result: FALSE compliance — audit finding guaranteed Fix: Separate maintenance from license entitlements. License type field!.

Trap 5: Phantom Demand from Retired CIs. Installs on retired/stolen CIs still counted Retired CI (installstatus=7) should auto-exclude installs Leased/ignored devices need exclude-CI job Fix: Business rule on install — check CI status, set uexcludefromreconciliation.

Trap 6: First Reconciliation = Invoice. First run shows massive under-licensed Panic → emergency true-up at full retail Reality: First run = DATA QUALITY LOOP Normalize → dedup → exclude retired → re-run → THEN true-up Exam: First reconciliation is for data quality, not purchasing.

Trap 7: Dead SaaS Connector (No Waste Illusion). M365 connector stops syncing silently No new usage data → 'no inactive seats found' Reality: Connector dead, waste invisible Fix: Connector health monitoring + owner + alerting on sync failure.

Trap 8: Vendor/Publisher/PPN/Model Confusion. Vendor (corecompany) → Publisher (sampswpublisher) → PPN (sampswproductdefinition) → Software Model (cmdbsoftwareproductmodel) → Discovery Model (cmdbsamswdiscoverymodel) → Catalog Item (sccatitem) → Entitlement (almlicense) Wrong link at any step = broken reconciliation chain Exam: Disambiguate these 7 entities.

8 Traps Summary. 1 Metric Mismatch Technical Enforce match at creation 2 Duplicate Installs Technical Dedup rules (Exact/Major/Any) 3 Unnormalized Titles Technical Normalize before auto-create 4 Maintenance = License Technical Separate license types 5 Phantom Demand Technical Exclude retired CIs 6 First Recon = Invoice Process Data quality loop first 7 Dead SaaS Connector Process Health monitoring + owner 8 Entity Confusion Process Disambiguate 7 entities
